data.name: Midnight Moving Crew
data.detailed_description:
Midnight Moving Crew is a 1-4 player co-op horror simulation game where the satisfaction of packing up a house meets the paranormal. The housing market is booming, and people want out of their homes fast, usually because their house is undeniably haunted. That’s where you come in. Your objective? Clock in, pack up every single cardboard box, load the truck, and get out alive before your whole crew joins the undead.

The Daily Grind (With a Chance of Death)

This isn't your average cozy simulator. Packing a house takes efficiency and a very high tolerance for the supernatural. Coordinate to carry the heavy furniture, pack the fragile items, and tape up boxes while keeping an eye on the shadows. The house’s haunting occupants don’t take kindly to you touching their stuff, and the longer you stay inside, the angrier they get.

Stay Safe from the Undead Inhabitants of the Houses

Moving a couch is hard enough without a vengeful spirit trying to hurl it back at you. Every entity haunting these halls operates on its own twisted rules, and figuring out what sets them off is the difference between completing the contract or dying at the hands of a demon.

Gear Up for the Shift

Earn hard cash by successfully completing contracts to upgrade your crew's gear. But don't forget to invest in your survival: flashlights, EMF detectors, and defensive wards are just as important as cardboard boxes.

Key Features

  • 1-4 Player Online Co-op: Work together with up to three friends, or brave the night shift completely alone. Divide and conquer the packing list, or huddle together in the living room while the lights flicker.

  • Guaranteed Hauntings: Every contract features a unique, unpredictable entity with distinct behaviors, triggers, and terrifying ways to end your employment permanently.

  • Contract-Based Progression: Choose your jobs wisely from the neighborhood board. Start with small, mildly spooky houses and work your way up to sprawling, heavily cursed Victorian mansions that pay top dollar.

EMPLOYEE NOTICE: Midnight Moving Crew is not responsible for any loss of sanity, spectral possession, or spontaneous termination of life. Remember to always lift with your legs, not your back.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2500u or Intel Core i5-8250U (4 Cores, 8 Threads, upto 3.4 GHz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050ti or Radeon RX 470 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1080p 60FPS
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or Intel Core i5-8400 (6 cores, 6 Threads, upto 4.4 GHz)
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 or Radeon RX 5600 XT (6GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1440p 120FPS
